routes.label: Complete the L to a square

question:
Figure \(ABCD\) is a square. Inside this square three smaller squares are drawn with side lengths as labeled. The area of the shaded L-shaped region is

[Figure 1](figures/2000_AMC_8_Q06_question_fig1.svg)
solution:
The shaded L becomes a square when we include the central square of side \(3\). This makes subtraction of areas useful.

The upper-left unit square shows that the shaded vertical strip has width \(1\). The lower-right unit square shows that the shaded bottom strip has height \(1\). Therefore the shaded region together with the central square has width \(1+3=4\) and height \(3+1=4\).

This \(4\)-by-\(4\) square consists exactly of the shaded region and the central \(3\)-by-\(3\) square, with no overlap of their interiors. Hence the shaded area is
\[
4\cdot4-3\cdot3=16-9=7.
\]
The answer is \(\boxed{7}\) square units, choice A.
